details: The US Consumer Price Index (CPI) for July came in at 3.4% year-over-year, with core CPI at 2.5%, both matching market expectations. This "in-line" report has slightly eased concerns about a Federal Reserve interest rate hike in September, leaving the decision a "coin flip." While some altcoins like Ethereum and Dogecoin saw modest gains, Bitcoin's price reaction was muted, remaining under pressure near $64,000, suggesting the cooling inflation was largely priced in.
title: US July Inflation Aligns with Expectations, Fed Hike Odds Shift

details: The U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) is scheduled to hold an open meeting on August 14, 2026, to consider proposing "Regulation Crypto." This framework aims to create a tailored offering regime for certain crypto asset investment contracts, potentially including streamlined disclosure requirements, safe harbors, and registration exemptions. This move signals the SEC's intention to advance regulatory certainty for the crypto industry.
title: SEC to Consider Tailored Crypto Regulation on August 14

details: An estimated 22,000 Bitcoin (valued at approximately $15 billion) was moved to safer wallets following a security exploit targeting Coldcard hardware wallets. This event contributed to a slight decline in Bitcoin's price and a generally bearish sentiment in the market, despite consistent inflows into spot Bitcoin ETFs.
title: Coldcard Hardware Wallet Exploit Leads to BTC Movement

details: Russian regulators are implementing new rules that will restrict retail cryptocurrency trading to only Bitcoin, Ethereum, and Tether (USDT). Additionally, a significant annual purchase limit of 300,000 rubles (approximately $3,600) will be imposed on non-qualified investors.
title: Russia Restricts Retail Crypto Trading to BTC, ETH, USDT

details: The Blockchain Association has filed an amicus brief in support of Custodia Bank's Supreme Court petition. Custodia is challenging the Federal Reserve's denial of its access to a master account, which would provide direct access to the central bank's payment systems. This legal effort aims to ensure lawful digital asset businesses can access essential banking services and compete on equal footing.
title: Blockchain Association Supports Custodia's Fed Master Account Bid
